subject: integration
name: Boltz
summary: Pays a Lightning invoice from on-chain Bitcoin through Boltz's public API (api.boltz.exchange). The browser rebuilds the swap's scripts and address from its own keys and refuses a mismatch, so Boltz can only claim by revealing the invoice's preimage, and the person can refund alone after at most 1152 blocks. Nothing checks that Boltz pays, its quoted fees, or the Bitcoin node it reads the chain from (a public Esplora server by default). After Pay Boltz sees the invoice and refund key. Level 3, not 4: it relies on Boltz. Judged here by its publisher.
